name: goldspotter
description: Photo scanner that marks circuit-board parts likely to carry recoverable precious metals.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && vite build
scripts.test: tsx --test test/validate.test.ts test/interpret.test.ts test/image.test.ts test/rateLimit.test.ts test/scanTypes.test.ts test/crop.test.ts test/prompt.test.ts test/analyzeFallback.test.ts test/postprocess.test.ts test/markers.test.ts test/timeouts.test.ts
